gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the Queen caused a stir.
The report was highly ___ (CRITICISE) of the ministry.
gaps.explanation: 'Be critical of' — adjective; 'criticism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The company needs to ___ (MODERN) its factories.
The museum's ___ (EXHIBIT) of Egyptian art opens on Friday.
gaps.explanation: 'An exhibition' = a public display of art; 'an exhibit' is a single item.

gaps.sentence: He made a full ___ (RECOVER) after six months.
The ___ (DIFFICULT) terrain slowed the rescue team.
gaps.explanation: 'Difficult terrain' — adjective needed; 'difficulty' is the noun.
'Cause drowsiness' — the quality noun from drowsy.
'Appealed for calm' — the set phrase uses 'calm' as noun.
